source_text:
3.35 Ἀφρικανοῦ· πρὸς <αὐτό> Κύκνου δεξιὸς ὄρχις περιαπτόμενος παύει
τὴν νόσον.
pass_a_gloss: 3.35 Of-Africanus: toward <the-same>. Of-a-swan the-right testicle being-fastened-around makes-to-cease the sickness.
pass_b_english: Of Africanus: toward the same. The right testicle of a swan, hung around, stops the disease.

choices.why: κύκνος is the bird. Not the constellation Cygnus as a name.
περιάπτω is to hang on the body as an amulet. Not 'circling'.
Lock restoration: the same inflammation as 3.34. Not 'to him'.

anf_compare.notes: No PD English of the Cesti body; ANF has the letters only.
